_about: Checked fixes to Yahoo's data. The pipeline re-applies them after every download (datapipe/prices.py apply_corrections and
apply_distribution_corrections), so a new Yahoo download can't undo them.
closes: 'close' is the right close (split-adjusted, like Yahoo's), 'replaces' is the wrong value Yahoo shows; a fix is only applied
while Yahoo still shows that value, otherwise it is skipped and reported in meta.json. The adjusted close that day is scaled by the same ratio.
distributions: 'amount' is the issuer's amount per unit on that ex-date ('replaces' = Yahoo's amount, null if Yahoo has none; amount 0
removes a distribution the issuer never paid). Adjusted closes before the ex-date are rescaled the way Yahoo builds them.
checkedFlatRuns: runs of identical closes a person has checked and found genuine, so the stuck-price check stops reporting them.
